The skin has an overly plastic-like, high-gloss sheen that feels inconsistent with natural vegetable waxiness. The light reflections are sharp but the underlying texture seems smudged.
Slight softening/blurring at the edges where the fingers grip the cucumber, suggesting minor boundary fusion or depth-of-field artifacts common in AI generation.
